title: Battelle Brainstorms injectable interface

tellings.quote: According to Battelle's own 2020 press release, their team progressed to phase two of the program.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, describes a 2020 programme called Brainstorms, run with the Air Force Research Lab, the US Air Force's science arm, to develop a link between brain and machine that could be injected rather than surgically implanted. He says that according to a 2020 press release from Battelle, a private research organisation, its team moved on to the second phase, and he mentions Carnegie Mellon University as also involved. He tells it to show how far secret brain technology work may have gone.
